doc.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1978-Fall Transcript

title: Which songs he enjoys playing
summary: He prefers new songs and tires of them after six or seven months.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Listening to classical music, then and now

blocks.x: It's kind of like the Wild Chopitulas are now broken, some of them are broken up into the Neville brothers, and they're not exclusive groups. Uh, what song are you happiest with that you've done? Which one do you enjoy playing the most?

The ones that, the new ones. After I play them for about six or seven months, I'm ready to get on something else. It's just the new things that are really interesting to you when you're playing the music.
